name: Brothers
doc: Brothers - Brotherly Love (GF summon): the GF cinematic engine run from the two script files (mag204_b.00 / .01, its parameters) and the 10 parts it streams from the battle folder (mag204_b.02 to .11, the game's) - the GF, its bones, prims, sprites and particles, the action results. The program calls the GF's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag_brothers.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.
